verses.text: So think of us as servants of Christ, trusted with the secret truths of God.
Those who are trusted with something must prove to be faithful.
It matters very little to me if I am judged by you or by any human court. I do not even judge myself.
My conscience is clear, but that does not make me right. It is the Lord who judges me.

So do not judge anything before the right time. Wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness, and he will show the secret aims of people's hearts. Then each person will receive their praise from God.

Brothers and sisters, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to help you. I want you to learn the meaning of the saying, "Do not go beyond what is written." Then you will not be proud of one person and look down on another.
What makes you better than anyone else? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you received it, why do you boast as if you did not?
You already have all you want! You are already rich! You have become kings without us! I wish you really were kings, so that we could be kings with you!
It seems to me that God has put us apostles last in line, like people sentenced to die. We have become a show for the whole world, for angels and for people.
We are fools for Christ, but you are so wise in Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are honoured, but we are looked down on!
Right up to this hour we are hungry and thirsty. We do not have enough clothes. We are beaten, and we have no home.
We work hard with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless them. When we are attacked, we put up with it.
When people say bad things about us, we answer kindly. Even now, we are treated like the rubbish of the world, the dirt everyone scrapes off.
I am not writing this to shame you. I am warning you as my own dear children.
You may have ten thousand teachers in Christ, but you do not have many fathers. I became your father in Christ Jesus when I brought you the good news.
So I beg you, follow my example.
That is why I am sending Timothy to you. He is my dear and faithful son in the Lord. He will remind you of the way I live in Christ Jesus, which is what I teach in every church everywhere.
Some of you have become proud, as if I were not coming to you.
But I will come to you very soon, if the Lord wants me to. Then I will find out not just what these proud people are saying, but what power they have.
For God's kingdom is not a matter of talk, but of power.
Which do you want? Shall I come to you with a stick, or with love and a gentle spirit?
